Search summary: ski area from about 1,300 m to 3,600 m (glacier), 'more than 2,300 m of vertical'

Search summary of Les 2 Alpes pages: 200 km of marked slopes; 42 lifts. A by-type list in the same summary (8 'cable cars' — probably gondolas and cable cars together — 24 chairlifts, 19 ski tows) adds up to 51, so it is not used. skiresort.info: gondolas and chairlifts predominate, with drag lifts in the valley beginner area and on the glacier. Hourly capacity and colour split not found.

Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools (e.g. ESF) and rental shops operate in the resort villages

character: Les 2 Alpes is a high Oisans resort whose ski area rises from about 1,300 m to a glacier at about 3,600 m, giving more than 2,300 m of vertical on about 200 km of marked pistes. The village sits on a plateau with most of the terrain above it, and the glacier at the top has also been used for summer skiing (reference).
learning: Reference: beginner areas are at village level and on the glacier; confirm beginner-lift access and lessons for 2026-27.

announcedOpening.text: Les 2 Alpes opens 28 Nov 2026 (France Montagnes 2026-27 opening list, per search summary).

season.typicalText: Usually late November or early December to late April, plus glacier skiing in summer (reference; confirm).
season.notes: No 2026-27 closing date was found. Past seasons were not captured.
